account_error_email_taken: There is already an account with that email. Sign in instead.
account_error_invalid_email: That does not look like an email address.
account_error_offline: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
account_error_password_too_short: The password needs at least 8 characters.
account_error_rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
account_error_too_many_attempts: Too many tries with that code.
account_error_unknown: Something went wrong on the server. Try again in a moment.
account_error_wrong_credentials: That email and password do not match an account.
account_forgot_description: Enter your email, and a 6-digit code will be sent to it.
account_page_description: Sign in to keep your progress on more than one device. It is copied to a server in Frankfurt, tied to your email. Without an account, nothing leaves this browser.
account_reset_description: Enter the code sent to {email} and choose a new password.
account_status_code_sent: A new code is on its way.
common_app_tagline: Learn to read Japanese by typing it.
leaderboards_following_empty: Share your username, or follow someone by theirs.
leaderboards_following_error_load: Could not load who you follow. Check your connection.
leaderboards_following_error_unknown: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
leaderboards_following_rename_descriptio: People find you by this name.
leaderboards_following_rename_error_inva: That will not work. Use 3 to 20 letters, digits, - or _.
leaderboards_following_signed_out: Sign in to compare your score with people you follow.
leaderboards_groups_create_description: Everyone in a group sees the same board. You can invite people once it exists.
leaderboards_groups_create_hint: Up to 40 characters. Everyone in the group sees it.
leaderboards_groups_delete_description: The board goes for everyone in it, and its invite and display links stop working. Nobody loses their own progress.
leaderboards_groups_display_gone: This display link was turned off.
leaderboards_groups_empty: Nobody else yet. Invite people with the button above.
leaderboards_groups_error_expired: This invite has ended. Ask for a new one.
leaderboards_groups_error_invalid: That will not work. Use 1 to 40 characters.
leaderboards_groups_error_limit: That is the most groups you can be in, or the group is full.
leaderboards_groups_error_load: Could not load this board. Check your connection.
leaderboards_groups_error_not_found: This invite does not work. Check the link, or ask for a new one.
leaderboards_groups_invite_description: Scan the code or send the link. Anyone who has it can join.
leaderboards_groups_invite_label_qr: QR code with the invite link
leaderboards_groups_invite_off: Invites are off, so nobody new can join.
leaderboards_groups_join_description: Everyone in the group sees each other's name and score on one board.
leaderboards_groups_leave_description: You go off the board. To come back you need a new invite.
leaderboards_groups_remove_description: They go off the board and are not told. They can come back with an invite link that still works.
leaderboards_groups_screen_description: Open this link on the computer connected to the screen. It shows the board full screen and keeps it up to date, without signing in.
leaderboards_groups_screen_off: The screen link is off, so nothing shows the board.
leaderboards_groups_screen_warning: Anyone with this link sees everyone's name and score.
leaderboards_page_description: Your score next to the people you follow, and in your groups.
profile_view_error_load: Could not load this profile. Check your connection.
profile_view_missing_description: Nobody is called @{username}. Names have to match exactly.
session_typing_error_corpus: The sentence library could not be loaded, so you are seeing the same few practice sentences. Reloading may help.
session_typing_hint_reading: Up arrow or click for the reading
session_typing_hint_reading_touch: Tap the word for its reading
session_typing_warning_unsaved: Your browser is not storing progress, so this session will be forgotten.
session_welcome_how: Type the sound of each character.
session_welcome_stuck: New to Japanese? Miss twice and it shows you.
settings_data_description: Everything you type stays in this browser unless you turn on sync. Nothing else is sent anywhere.
settings_delete_description: This deletes every character you have learned and every sentence you have read. There is no copy anywhere else, so it cannot be undone. Export first if you want to keep it.
settings_delete_description_synced: This deletes every character you have learned and every sentence you have read, on this device and in the synced copy. It cannot be undone. Your account stays, with nothing in it. Export first if you want to keep it.
settings_delete_done: Every character you had learned and every sentence you had read is gone.
settings_delete_error_sync: Could not reach the server, so nothing was deleted. Try again when you are online.
settings_install_description: Open yomukana from your home screen, like any other app.
settings_install_home_screen: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
settings_install_unavailable: yomukana is installed already, or this browser does not offer to install it.
settings_profile_error_invalid: That will not work. Use up to 32 characters.
settings_profile_error_load: Could not load your profile. Check your connection.
settings_profile_error_offensive: That name is not allowed. Try another.
settings_profile_hint_display_name: Shown instead of your username. Up to 32 characters.
settings_profile_label_qr: QR code with the link to your profile
settings_profile_share_description: Anyone with this link sees your card and score. A phone camera opens it straight from the code.
settings_profile_signed_out: Your profile comes with an account: a username people can follow you by.
settings_sync_description: Sign in to keep your progress on more than one device. It is then copied to a server in Frankfurt, tied to your email. Without an account, nothing leaves this browser.
settings_sync_error_expired: Your sign-in expired. Sign in again to keep syncing.
settings_sync_error_failed: Could not reach the server. Your progress is safe here and syncs next time.
stats_detail_chart_label: Recognition time by day. Lower is faster.
stats_detail_empty: You have not read this one yet.
stats_empty_description: Read a few sentences and your reading speed will show up here.
stats_grid_legend: Each box fills up with how fast you read that character. Read it right and the clock stops at your first key. Get it wrong and it runs until you get it right.
stats_page_description: How fast you recognise each character, and what still slows you down.
stats_score_chart_label: Your score, sentence by sentence, since you started.
stats_words_description: Words you have read in kanji, slowest first.
stats_words_empty: Kanji stay hidden until your kana is solid. Once they start appearing, the words you read show up here.
stats_words_empty_open: Kanji have started appearing, but you have not read one yet. The next sentence with one will put it here.
